question: In the last two weeks, did this business use Artificial Intelligence (AI) in any of its business functions? (Examples of AI: machine learning, natural language processing, virtual agents, voice recognition, etc.)
construct: business-reported current AI use in any business function during the last two weeks
estimator_denominator: nonresponse-adjusted weighted businesses responding to the question

period_selection_provenance.selection_basis: nearest BTOS reference-period midpoint to the registered May 16 fallback anchor; selected before inspecting cycle-202611 Question 7 / Answer 1 sector observations
period_selection_provenance.outcome_inspection_ordering: cycle-202611 outcomes were inspected only after the protocol was merged and post-merge CI passed

national_response_distribution.rounding_note: The three one-decimal published shares sum to 100.1 because of source rounding; no component is renormalized or altered.

crosswalk.role: taxonomy annotation only; no RPS observation or cross-source statistic is part of this checkpoint

suppression.committed_value_rule: Represent a source-suppressed estimate and standard error as null with suppression_code S.
suppression.inference_rule: Never infer, back-solve, complement, interpolate, or otherwise reconstruct a source-suppressed BTOS value.

source_mutability.validation_rule: The online validator must require these exact SHA-256 hashes before comparing workbook values. Hash drift means a new source vintage or revision must be reviewed; it must not silently rewrite this checkpoint.
